front: Current Python import for Lakeflow Pipelines
back: `from pyspark import pipelines as dp`; `import dlt` still works. Code mới dùng module `dp`.

front: `@dp.table` vs `@dp.materialized_view`
back: `@dp.table` with a streaming DataFrame creates a streaming table; `@dp.materialized_view` uses a batch read. Kiểu read quyết định loại dataset.

front: Python operations never allowed in pipeline dataset code
back: `collect()`, `count()`, `toPandas()`, `save()`, `saveAsTable()`, `start()`, `toTable()`. Hàm dataset chỉ return DataFrame.

front: Auto Loader in a pipeline: checkpoint and schema location?
back: Managed automatically by Lakeflow Pipelines. Ngoài pipeline thì phải set `checkpointLocation` và `cloudFiles.schemaLocation`.

front: Recommended Auto Loader file detection mode
back: File notification mode with file events (`cloudFiles.useManagedFileEvents`). Một queue cho mọi stream trên external location.

front: Schema evolution mode: never fail, keep new fields
back: `rescue`: new columns go to `_rescued_data`. `addNewColumns` (default) fail rồi restart với schema mới.

ref.label: Auto Loader schema inference and evolution

front: Materialized view: best fit
back: Aggregates and joins over data that is updated or deleted; always correct at refresh. Incremental refresh chỉ trên serverless.

front: Query changed on a streaming table
back: Only new rows use the new logic; run a full refresh to reprocess old rows. Row cũ không tự tính lại.

front: Add a source to a streaming table without full refresh
back: Define another append flow (`CREATE FLOW ... INSERT INTO target BY NAME`). Không cần `UNION`.

front: One-time backfill into a streaming table
back: `INSERT ONCE INTO` flow (or `once=True`); re-runs only on full refresh. Dùng cho dữ liệu lịch sử.

front: AUTO CDC former name
back: APPLY CHANGES (`dlt.apply_changes`); same syntax. Exam guide dùng tên AUTO CDC.

front: Default `stored_as_scd_type`
back: SCD Type 1. Truyền 2 hoặc `STORED AS SCD TYPE 2` để giữ history với `__START_AT`, `__END_AT`.

front: Late CDC event with an older sequence value (SCD Type 1)
back: Discarded; the highest `SEQUENCE BY` value wins. Thứ tự tới không quyết định.

front: `TRACK HISTORY ON`
back: Only the listed columns create new SCD Type 2 versions; other columns update the current version. Giảm số version thừa.

front: `APPLY AS TRUNCATE WHEN` limitation
back: Supported only for SCD Type 1. SCD Type 2 không hỗ trợ truncate.

front: Source has only periodic full snapshots
back: AUTO CDC FROM SNAPSHOT (`create_auto_cdc_from_snapshot_flow`). So sánh snapshot để suy ra thay đổi.

front: Lakeflow-only features vs Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines
back: AUTO CDC, expectations, queryable event log, update flows, foreachBatch sinks, continuous mode. SDP có streaming table, materialized view, flow.

front: Delta sink and update output mode
back: Not supported; Delta sinks take append and complete. Dùng `foreachBatch` với `MERGE` để có hành vi giống update.

front: Exactly-once writes inside `foreachBatch`
back: Pass `txnAppId` and `txnVersion = batchId` to each Delta write. `foreachBatch` tự nó chỉ at-least-once.

ref.label: Delta table streaming reads and writes

front: Full refresh vs reset streaming flow checkpoints
back: Full refresh clears streaming table data and checkpoints; reset checkpoints keeps the data and reprocesses the source. Reset chỉ áp cho streaming table, chọn flow qua `reset_checkpoint_selection`.

front: Block accidental full refresh of a table
back: Set `pipelines.reset.allowed` to `false` on the table. Dùng cho bronze đọc Kafka hay file có retention ngắn.

front: NULL values in the AUTO CDC sequencing column
back: Not supported. Lọc hoặc sửa NULL trước khi vào flow AUTO CDC.

front: Add or reorder streaming sources without a new checkpoint
back: Source evolution on Databricks Runtime 18.2+: enable `spark.sql.streaming.queryEvolution.enableSourceEvolution` and name every source with `.name()`, starting from a new checkpoint. Mặc định source được nhận diện theo vị trí.
